game_title: Input Interpreter – Lava River Crossing Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the volcanologist must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Input Interpreter: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava River Crossing, repeat each round: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly. Each round, cinder bats strike the forge anvil, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the trust value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the forge anvil from cinder bats in Lava River Crossing: keep the trust meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 80-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: trust drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 80-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 10 (extended tier): Input Interpreter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Lava River Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 80 seconds while trust > 0.
